name: get_device_info
description: Get BIG-IP device information: hostname, version, platform, serial number, management IP, failover state, and active modules.

name: get_system_provision
description: List provisioned modules and their levels (e.g. nominal, dedicated, minimum).

name: get_failover_status
description: Get the high-availability failover status of the BIG-IP device.

name: get_sync_status
description: Get the configuration sync status across the device group.

name: sync_config
description: Trigger a configuration sync to a specified device group.

name: save_config
description: Save the running configuration to disk.

name: get_system_clock
description: Get the current system date and time from the BIG-IP.

name: get_system_dns
description: Get the DNS configuration (nameservers and search domains).

name: get_system_ntp
description: Get NTP server configuration.

name: get_system_license
description: Get BIG-IP license information including registration key and licensed modules.

name: list_virtual_servers
description: List all LTM virtual servers.

name: get_virtual_server
description: Get detailed information about a specific virtual server including profiles, policies, rules, persistence, and status.

name: create_virtual_server
description: Create a new LTM virtual server.

name: modify_virtual_server
description: Modify an existing LTM virtual server.

name: delete_virtual_server
description: Delete an LTM virtual server.

name: list_pools
description: List all LTM pools with their load balancing mode and monitor.

name: get_pool
description: Get detailed information about a pool including its members and their status.

name: create_pool
description: Create a new LTM pool.

name: modify_pool
description: Modify an existing LTM pool.

name: delete_pool
description: Delete an LTM pool.

name: list_pool_members
description: List all members of a specific pool with their state and session status.

name: add_pool_member
description: Add a node as a member to a pool.

name: remove_pool_member
description: Remove a member from a pool.

name: set_pool_member_state
description: Enable, disable (mark offline gracefully), or force-offline a pool member.

name: list_nodes
description: List all LTM nodes with their addresses and status.

name: get_node
description: Get detailed information about a specific node.

name: create_node
description: Create a new LTM node.

name: delete_node
description: Delete an LTM node.

name: set_node_state
description: Enable, disable, or force-offline a node.

name: list_monitors
description: List health monitors of a given type.

name: get_monitor
description: Get detailed configuration of a specific health monitor.

name: list_irules
description: List all iRules.

name: get_irule
description: Get the content/code of a specific iRule.

name: list_profiles
description: List profiles of a specific type.

name: list_persistence_profiles
description: List persistence profiles of a specific type.

name: list_data_groups
description: List internal data groups.

name: get_data_group
description: Get the records of an internal data group.

name: list_policies
description: List all LTM policies.

name: get_policy
description: Get detailed configuration of an LTM policy including its rules.

name: list_snat_pools
description: List all SNAT pools.

name: list_virtual_addresses
description: List all LTM virtual addresses.

name: list_ssl_certificates
description: List all SSL certificates on the BIG-IP.

name: list_ssl_keys
description: List all SSL keys on the BIG-IP.

name: list_vlans
description: List all VLANs with their tag and interfaces.

name: get_vlan
description: Get detailed VLAN configuration including interfaces.

name: create_vlan
description: Create a new VLAN.

name: delete_vlan
description: Delete a VLAN.

name: list_self_ips
description: List all self IP addresses.

name: create_self_ip
description: Create a new self IP address.

name: delete_self_ip
description: Delete a self IP address.

name: list_routes
description: List all static routes.

name: list_interfaces
description: List all network interfaces and their status.

name: list_trunks
description: List all trunk groups (link aggregation).

name: list_route_domains
description: List all route domains.

name: list_gtm_wideips
description: List GTM wide IPs of a specified record type.

name: get_gtm_wideip
description: Get detailed configuration of a GTM wide IP.

name: list_gtm_pools
description: List GTM pools of a specified record type.

name: list_gtm_datacenters
description: List all GTM data centers.

name: list_gtm_servers
description: List all GTM servers.

name: list_device_groups
description: List all device groups for HA clustering.

name: list_traffic_groups
description: List all traffic groups for HA failover.

name: run_bash_command
description: Execute a bash command on the BIG-IP device via the REST API.
